what: Palo Alto Networks sells cybersecurity: firewalls for networks, cloud security and AI-driven security operations software. It is pushing customers to buy all of it as one platform.
customers: Large companies, governments and service providers.
moat: A broad platform, a large installed base of firewalls to upsell and high switching costs once security tools are integrated.
risks: A breach of its own products
opportunities: Revenue grew about 24% last year and about 19% a year over three years
Gross margin of 70% with cash exceeding debt
Customers consolidating many security vendors onto one platform raises revenue per customer
watch: Next-generation security annual recurring revenue and platform consolidation wins.
